original_coverage_E: Ghana: Greater Accra Region (except the four Dangme-coast districts Ada East, Ada West, Shai Osudoku, Ningo/Prampram) plus Eastern, Central, Western and Western North Regions
coverage_T: Ghana (Greater Accra Region (Ablekuma Central Municipal, Ablekuma North Municipal, Ablekuma West Municipal, Accra Metropolis, Adenta Municipal, Ashaiman Municipal, Ayawaso Central Municipal, Ayawaso East Municipal, Ayawaso North Municipal, Ayawaso West, Ga Central Municipal, Ga East, Ga North Municipal, Ga South Municipal, Ga West Municipal, Korle Klottey Municipal, Kpone Katamanso, Krowor Municipal, La Dade-kotopon, La-nkwantanang-madina, Ledzokuku Municipal, Okaikwei North Municipal, Tema Metropolitan, Tema West Municipal, Weija Gbawe Municipal ADM2 only), Eastern Region [entire ADM1], Central Region [entire ADM1], Western Region [entire ADM1], Western North Region [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Boundary defined; four eastern Greater Accra (Dangme) districts moved to seat 388 to lift the Togo–Volta seat into band.
notes: Contiguous (Gulf of Guinea coast plus inland Eastern/Western North). Ghana region pops from 2021 census scaled to 35.4m; ADM2 split of Greater Accra estimated.

original_coverage_E: Ghana: Ashanti, Ahafo, Bono, Bono East, Northern, Savannah, North East, Upper East and Upper West Regions
coverage_T: Ghana (Ashanti Region [entire ADM1], Ahafo Region [entire ADM1], Bono Region [entire ADM1], Bono East Region [entire ADM1], Northern Region [entire ADM1], Savannah Region [entire ADM1], North East Region [entire ADM1], Upper East Region [entire ADM1], Upper West Region [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Boundary defined (Ashanti plus the whole savanna north).
notes: Contiguous. 2021 census region pops scaled to 35.4m (geoBoundaries ADM1 uses the 16 post-2018 regions).

original_coverage_E: Côte d’Ivoire: Abidjan, Lagunes, Comoé, Gôh-Djiboua and Bas-Sassandra districts (southern coast)
coverage_T: Côte d’Ivoire (District Autonome D'Abidjan [entire ADM1], Lagunes [entire ADM1], Comoe [entire ADM1], Goh-Djiboua [entire ADM1], Bas-Sassandra [entire ADM1])
notes: Contiguous coastal strip from Comoé to Bas-Sassandra. geoBoundaries ADM1 = 14 districts (2016); regional pops approximate (2021 census scaled to 33.0m).

original_coverage_E: Côte d’Ivoire: Yamoussoukro, Lacs, Vallée du Bandama, Montagnes, Sassandra-Marahoué, Savanes, Woroba, Zanzan and Denguélé districts (centre and north)
coverage_T: Côte d’Ivoire (District Autonome De Yamoussoukro [entire ADM1], Lacs [entire ADM1], Valle Du Bandama [entire ADM1], Montagnes [entire ADM1], Sassandra-Marahoue [entire ADM1], Savanes [entire ADM1], Woroba [entire ADM1], Zanzan [entire ADM1], Denguele [entire ADM1])
notes: Contiguous. Regional pops approximate (2021 census scaled to 33.0m).

original_coverage_E: Niger: Niamey, Tillabéri and Dosso regions plus the Tahoua-region departments
coverage_T: Niger (Niamey [entire ADM1], Tillaberi [entire ADM1], Dossa [entire ADM1], Tahoua/Agadez (Abalak, Bagaroua, Birni-N'Konni, Bouza, Illéla, Keita, Madaoua, Malbaza, Tahoua, Tahoua Ville, Tassara, Tchintabaraden, Tillia ADM2 only))
notes: geoBoundaries Niger ADM1 merges regions (Tahoua/Agadez, Zinder/Diffa), so the Tahoua/Agadez unit is split at ADM2 (departments) between 369 and 370. Pops from 2012 census scaled to 28.6m, Niamey up-weighted for faster growth.

original_coverage_E: Niger: Maradi, Zinder and Diffa regions plus the Agadez-region departments
coverage_T: Niger (Maradi [entire ADM1], Zinder/Diffa [entire ADM1], Tahoua/Agadez (Aderbissinat, Arlit, Bilma, Iférouane, Ingall, Tchirozérine ADM2 only))
notes: Contiguous (Agadez touches Zinder/Diffa and Maradi). See seat 369 note on merged ADM1.

original_coverage_E: Mali: Bamako, Kayes, Koulikoro and Sikasso regions
coverage_T: Mali (Bamako [entire ADM1], Kayes [entire ADM1], Koulikouro [entire ADM1], Sikasso [entire ADM1])
notes: Contiguous. Mali ADM1 pops based on 2009 census (outdated) scaled to 25.0m with Bamako up-weighted; low confidence on the split.

original_coverage_E: Mauritania (entire) plus Mali: Ségou, Mopti, Tombouctou, Gao (incl. Ménaka) and Kidal regions
coverage_T: Mauritania [entire ADM0]; Mali (Segou [entire ADM1], Mopti [entire ADM1], Tombouctou [entire ADM1], Gao [entire ADM1], Kidal [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Constituency renamed; Ségou and Mopti placed here to balance population.
notes: Contiguous: Mauritania borders Tombouctou region. Sahelian Moor/Tuareg/Songhai/Fulani cultural link. geoBoundaries has no separate Ménaka ADM1; it sits in Gao. Mauritania 5.2m.

original_coverage_E: Burkina Faso except Est, Centre-Est and Centre-Sud regions
coverage_T: Burkina Faso (Boucle du Mouhoun [entire ADM1], Cascades [entire ADM1], Centre [entire ADM1], Centre-Nord [entire ADM1], Centre-Ouest [entire ADM1], Hauts-Bassins [entire ADM1], Nord [entire ADM1], Plateau Central [entire ADM1], Sahel [entire ADM1], Sud-Ouest [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Reblocked: old seat held entire Burkina Faso (24.6m, too big); east/south-east regions moved to seat 381.
notes: Contiguous. Regional pops from 2019 census scaled to 24.5m.

original_coverage_E: Senegal except Ziguinchor, Sédhiou and Kolda; Gambia (entire); Cabo Verde (entire)
coverage_T: Senegal (Dakar [entire ADM1], Thies [entire ADM1], Diourbel [entire ADM1], Kaolack [entire ADM1], Kaffrine [entire ADM1], Fatick [entire ADM1], Louga [entire ADM1], Saint Louis [entire ADM1], Matam [entire ADM1], Tambacounda [entire ADM1], Kedougou [entire ADM1]); Gambia [entire ADM0]; Cabo Verde [entire ADM0]
changes_vs_old: Casamance (Ziguinchor, Sédhiou, Kolda) moved to seat 380 because old Senegal+Gambia+Cabo Verde was 22.8m (over band).
notes: Contiguous by land (Senegal surrounds Gambia). Cabo Verde is a sea/air link of about 600 km to Dakar (long ocean link accepted; historic Senegambia–Cabo Verde Creole ties). Senegal regional pops approximate (scaled to 19.0m).

original_coverage_E: Guinea (entire), Guinea-Bissau (entire), Senegal: Casamance (Ziguinchor, Sédhiou, Kolda regions)
coverage_T: Guinea [entire ADM0]; Guinea-Bissau [entire ADM0]; Senegal (Ziguinchor [entire ADM1], Sedhiou [entire ADM1], Kolda [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Added Casamance (Senegal) to bring Senegambia seat under 20.8m.
notes: Contiguous: Casamance borders Guinea-Bissau and Guinea. Casamance shares Fula/Mandinka/Balanta/Diola culture with Guinea-Bissau and Guinea. Guinea 14.9m, Guinea-Bissau 2.25m.

original_coverage_E: Benin (entire) plus Burkina Faso Est, Centre-Est and Centre-Sud regions
coverage_T: Benin [entire ADM0]; Burkina Faso (Est [entire ADM1], Centre-Est [entire ADM1], Centre-Sud [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Renamed; added eastern Burkina Faso (from old whole-Burkina seat) to cure Burkina over-size.
notes: Contiguous via Benin–Burkina border (Atakora/Alibori with Est: Tapoa, Kompienga). Cultural link strongest with Gourmantche Est; Centre-Est/Centre-Sud added mainly for population balance (Mossi/Bissa/Kassena, bordering Togo and Ghana).

original_coverage_E: Sierra Leone and Liberia (entire); Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha attached
coverage_T: Sierra Leone [entire ADM0]; Liberia [entire ADM0]; Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha [entire ADM0]
changes_vs_old: Added UK South Atlantic territories (St Helena, Ascension, Tristan da Cunha, about 5,500 people).
notes: Remote: territories lie 2,000+ km out in the Atlantic (very long ocean link accepted); attached here because of historic Freetown–St Helena ties (liberated Africans) and the Atlantic West African coast. Their pop rounds to zero in K.

original_coverage_E: Togo (entire) with Ghana’s Volta and Oti Regions plus four Dangme-coast districts of eastern Greater Accra
coverage_T: Togo [entire ADM0]; Ghana (Volta Region [entire ADM1], Oti Region [entire ADM1], Greater Accra Region (Ada East, Ada West, Shai Osudoku, Ningo/prampram ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Volta/Oti ADM1 and four Greater Accra ADM2 districts defined; excluded from seats 361/362.
notes: Contiguous (Ewe coast and Volta basin; Ada districts adjoin Volta Region at the Volta estuary/river). Togo 9.6m; Ghana part about 3.2m. Dangme districts added to lift seat above 12.5m.
